definitions.gloss: to create; to produce; to bring into being
definitions.explanation: To make something new that did not exist before. Emphasizes the creative act of bringing something into existence from nothing or from raw materials.

definitions.gloss: to generate; to give rise to; to create (an atmosphere, situation)
definitions.explanation: To cause a condition, atmosphere, or situation to come about. Used for abstract things like moods, environments, and opportunities.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{製品|せいひん}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す。
この{工場|こうじょう}は{一日|いちにち}に{千個|せんこ}の{部品|ぶひん}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: This factory produces a thousand parts per day.

examples.japanese: {芸術家|げいじゅつか}は{何|なに}もないところから{美|うつく}しい{作品|さくひん}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: Artists create beautiful works from nothing.

examples.japanese: {温|あたた}かい{雰囲気|ふんいき}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す。
チームワークが{新|あたら}しいアイデアを{作|つく}り{出|だ}した。
{照明|しょうめい}と{音楽|おんがく}で{幻想的|げんそうてき}な{空間|くうかん}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}している。
examples.english: They are creating a fantastical space with lighting and music.

notes:
A compound verb combining {作|つく}る (to make) with {出|だ}す (to put out, to begin). The {出|だ}す component adds the nuance of bringing something into existence or producing output.

A transitive verb. Compared to simple {作|つく}る, {作|つく}り{出|だ}す emphasizes the creative or generative aspect — producing something new rather than simply assembling or constructing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to create an atmosphere
- {価値|かち}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to create value
- {利益|りえき}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to generate profit
- {新|あたら}しい{文化|ぶんか}を{作|つく}り{出|だ}す — to create a new culture
